QuestInfo.name: First Greeting with Jane Doe, the Town Resident
QuestInfo.0: It looks like #p425#, the City Clerk, is looking for someone to help with her work. Let's go check out #p431# in front of #m10003007#.
QuestInfo.1: #p425#, the City Clerk, asked me to greet #b#p412##k, a resident of the city. Since I've become a resident here too, greeting the cityspeople is a given, right? \r\n#rOnly characters at Level 12 or higher can complete this quest.#k
QuestInfo.2: I greeted #p412#, a resident of #m10003000#. As expected, the residents of this city seem to be quite full of personality.

0.0: "There isn't a whole lot you're forced to do as a resident of #m10003000#, but hey, if you're up for it, I'd highly recommend chatting with the locals around here. Come to think of it, it would be a good idea to go say hi to #p412# as well.\r\n- #p425#"

1.0: Haa... it's so cold... My legs feel so heavy that it's hard to even walk... But, who are you...? Pardon...? You're saying someone named #p425# suggested you come say hello to me...? How kind...
1.1: Thank you for talking to me like this... Since I've been staying in this hospital room for so long, even just having a normal conversation with people has become quite difficult... I'm truly happy...
1.2: I see... You've become a resident of this town... That's... wonderful news... Then, could you make me one promise...? If you could drop by here every now and then to listen to my stories, I would be really... so glad...

level.0: But you... your level seems a bit too low...
